title: Control Flow, Switches, and Boundaries
summary: Write clear decisions and repetition using if, switch, for, short statements, boolean operators, and boundary tests.
learningObjectives: Explain and apply Control Flow, Switches, and Boundaries
Test the contract with build and runtime evidence

sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Go uses `if`, `switch`, and one looping construct, `for`. Conditions do not use parentheses and must be boolean. `&&` and `||` short-circuit. An `if` can include a short initialization whose names remain scoped to its branches. Switch cases break automatically unless explicit `fallthrough` is used; conditionless switch can express ranges. Range loops yield index and value copies. Ensure every loop progresses toward termination and test immediately below, at, and above each threshold.
keyPoints: Go uses `if`, `switch`, and one looping construct, `for`.

bitwise operators are not logical short circuit
